lines.en: scene makotonewthree4
The grains of dirt underneath your fingernails now swim in the safety of your intestines because no amount of nights or days can calm you more than hardened keratin deposits and ironless blood.
lines.zh: 你指甲缝里的污垢颗粒，如今安全地游弋在你的肠子里，因为无论多少个日日夜夜，都不如硬化的角蛋白沉积和无铁之血更能让你平静。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree5
The inside of your heart is full of shit and {b}so is the world around you.{/b}
lines.zh: 你的心脏里面全是屎，{b}你周围的世界也是{/b}。

lines.en: I SPEAK TO YOU AND ONLY YOU
lines.zh: 我只对你、且只对你说话

lines.en: Open your mouth.

lines.en: FUCKING OPEN your FUCKING MOUTH you FUCKING worm.

lines.en: It will lessen the pain of what it means to be a MAN.

lines.en: The taste of tiny bits of your tongue will remind you of when she used to gnaw at yours.
lines.zh: 你舌头上那些碎屑的味道，会让你想起从前她啃咬你舌头的时候。

: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: scene makotonewthree7
I am where I am supposed to be- the outskirts of my throne of flesh and closer to a hole that I can sleep inside of.
lines.zh: 我在我该在的地方——我那血肉王座的边缘，离一个可以让我睡进去的洞更近了一些。

lines.en: A figure stands before me in pixelated glory, illuminated by the faint pink light of a SEX BUILDING.
lines.zh: 一个人影像素化地、荣光地立在我面前，被一栋性爱建筑微弱的粉色灯光照亮。

lines.en: Or at least what I think is a SEX BUILDING.
lines.zh: 或者，至少是我认为的性爱建筑。

lines.en: I have a history of mistaking all buildings for sex buildings and then proceeding to do bad things inside of them.
lines.zh: 我向来有个毛病：把所有建筑都错认成性爱建筑，然后进去做坏事。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree6
And then proceeding to do entirely consensual, not at all manipulative things inside of them.
lines.zh: 然后进去做一些完全你情我愿的、绝不带半点操纵的事。

lines.en: There are no blurred lines here- just ones that have been hastily drawn in the sand with a shard of glass pulled from the wreckage of a shattered windshield.
lines.zh: 这里没有模糊的界限——只有被一块从碎裂挡风玻璃的残骸里捡来的玻璃碎片，在沙地上仓促划出来的线。

lines.en: I kept one in a box somewhere.
lines.zh: 我曾经把一块收在某个盒子里。

lines.en: The box is gone now.
lines.zh: 那个盒子现在不见了。

lines.en: I wonder where it went.
lines.zh: 我想知道它去哪儿了。

lines.en: : Sensei? Why are you just staring at me like that?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你干嘛那样盯着我看？

lines.en: : {b}DON’T YOU WANNA FUUUUUUUUCK?{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你不想做——爱——吗？{/b}

lines.en: scene makotonewthree7
I try to speak to Makoto but she is so much smarter than me so she doesn’t understand anything.
lines.zh: 我试图跟 Makoto 说话，可她比我聪明太多了，所以她什么也听不懂。

lines.en: Then, like a snake, I poke and prod at a prison with my egg tooth.
lines.zh: 然后，像一条蛇，我用我的卵齿戳弄着一座监狱。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree8
And everything turns out okay.
lines.zh: 而结果一切都还好。

lines.en: : Sorry, did you say something?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你刚才说了什么吗？

lines.en: : I asked why you’ve just been standing there staring at me ever since you got here.
lines.zh: : 我问的是，你从一进来就站在那儿盯着我，到底在干嘛。

lines.en: : And...come to think of it, why are you here this late in the first place? I just closed the store.
lines.zh: : 还有……话说回来，你这么晚过来到底是为什么？我刚关店。

lines.en: : You closed the store and {i}didn’t{/i} immediately proceed to play with yourself? I am shocked.
lines.zh: : 你关了店，却{i}没有{/i}立刻开始玩自己？我震惊了。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree9
: That happened one time!
lines.zh: : 那才发生过一次！

lines.en: : {i}That I know of.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就我知道的而言。{/i}

lines.en: : Yes, that {i}you know of.{/i} And I probably don’t have to remind you of this, but that worked out very well for {i}both{/i} of us.
lines.zh: : 对，{i}就你知道的而言{/i}。而且我大概不用提醒你——那次对我们{i}两个{/i}来说结果都非常好。

lines.en: : Exactly. Which is why I’m surprised you’re not repeating the process again tonight.
lines.zh: : 正是。所以我才奇怪你今晚怎么没重复一遍那个流程。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree10
: Well, I...may have been open to more...{i}experimentation{/i} if you showed up at a reasonable time...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……如果你来得是时候，我可能还是会乐意多……{i}尝试一下{/i}的……

lines.en: : But it’s past midnight now and I have to be getting back to the dorm before Miku thinks I was...
lines.zh: : 可现在已经过了午夜，我得赶在 Miku 以为我……之前回宿舍。

lines.en: : Well, before Miku thinks something bad happened to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，赶在 Miku 以为我出了什么坏事之前。

lines.en: Past midnight? How did that happen?
lines.zh: 过了午夜？怎么会这样？

lines.en: : Don’t worry Makoto. You’re in good hands now that I’m here.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Makoto。既然我在这儿，你就安全了。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree11
: I am in {i}worse{/i} hands now that you’re here.
lines.zh: : 既然你在这儿，我才{i}更不安全{/i}呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你说得对。

lines.en: : I’m not going to let you just walk back to the dorm on your own at this hour, though. I’ll come with you.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会让你这个点一个人走回宿舍的。我陪你。

lines.en: : Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto？

lines.en: : I’m trying to be nice and-
lines.zh: : 我这是在好心——

lines.en: scene makotonewthree12
: Actually, how about we go somewhere {i}else{/i} instead?
lines.zh: : 话说，我们换个{i}地方{/i}怎么样？

lines.en: : Somewhere else? You literally just said you needed to be getting back home.
lines.zh: : 换个地方？你刚刚才说要回家了。

lines.en: : I did. But then I remembered the wonderful invention that is my cell phone and that my safety is all but a simple text message away.
lines.zh: : 我是说过。可我接着想起来手机这个伟大的发明——我的安全不过是一条短信的距离。

lines.en: : That doesn’t change the fact that it’s past midnight. I can’t imagine there’s anything open around here.
lines.zh: : 这改变不了已经过了午夜的事实。我想这附近也没什么还开着的地方。

lines.en: : Around {i}here,{/i} no. But who says we have to stay here?
lines.zh: : {i}这附近{/i}确实没有。可谁说我们必须待在这儿了？

lines.en: : Is this the real Makoto Miyamura suggesting that we sneak around to different parts of town after midnight?
lines.zh: : 这真的是 Makoto Miyamura 本人在提议，我们午夜之后溜到城里别的地方去？

lines.en: : What, you jerk off your teacher {i}one{/i} time and you think you’re some sort of badass now?
lines.zh: : 怎么，给你老师打了{i}一次{/i}飞机，就觉得自己是个狠角色了？

lines.en: scene makotonewthree13
: I never claimed to be a “badass.” In fact, I quite like staying out this late. Miku is the one who can’t stay awake past 11:00 PM.
lines.zh: : 我可从来没说过自己是什么「狠角色」。事实上，我还挺喜欢在外面待到这么晚的。Miku 才是那个过了晚上十一点就撑不住的人。

lines.en: : Strange. I didn’t really take you for a night owl.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我倒没看出来你是个夜猫子。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree14
: Yes, well...I think there’s something rather peaceful about the night.
lines.zh: : 是吗，嗯……我觉得夜晚有种相当平静的东西。

lines.en: : But I guess this is a weird time to say that as I’m about to suggest something that is the exact {i}opposite{/i} of peaceful.
lines.zh: : 不过我马上要提议一件跟平静完全{i}相反{/i}的事，这时候说这个确实有点怪。

lines.en: : Loud, aggressive sex in a love hotel? Count me in.
lines.zh: : 在情人宾馆里来一发吵闹又粗暴的性爱？算我一个。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree15
: More like a scenic walk through the urban district. The lights are beautiful this time of night.
lines.zh: : 倒不如说是去商业区散步看风景。这个时候的灯光很美。

lines.en: : Besides, I already gave you a chance to have sex with me and you said no.
lines.zh: : 再说，我已经给过你一次和我做爱的机会了，你说了不。

lines.en: : Honestly, I’d probably say no tonight as well. I was just being facetious.
lines.zh: : 说实话，今晚我大概也会说不。我刚才只是开玩笑。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree16
: What do you mean you’d say no? You were the one who essentially coerced me into a sexual relationship, weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你说不是什么意思？本质上是你把我胁迫进这段性关系的，不是吗？

lines.en: : I didn’t do anything that you didn’t already want me to do.
lines.zh: : 我做的每一件事，都是你本来就想要我做的。

lines.en: : But...if I wanted you to have sex with me-
lines.zh: : 可是……如果我想和你做爱——

lines.en: : I wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我也不会。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree15
: Yeah, I don’t understand that at all and I think you’re lying.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我完全理解不了，而且我觉得你在撒谎。

lines.en: : When have I ever lied to you before?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候对你撒过谎？

lines.en: : Probably tonight, but I try to turn my brain off after work so I’m not going to bother deducing which statements were true and which ones were false.
lines.zh: : 大概今晚就撒了，不过我下班后会尽量把脑子关掉，所以懒得去推断哪些话是真的、哪些是假的。

lines.en: : {i}Instead,{/i} I am going to begin walking to the urban district. If only there was an adult to accompany me and make sure I don’t end up passed out in an alley somewhere along the way.
lines.zh: : {i}我呢，{/i}要开始往商业区走了。要是能有个成年人陪着我，确保我不会昏死在半路某条小巷里就好了。

lines.en: : I guess all I can do is just...be that adult then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那我大概只能……去当那个成年人了，是吧？

lines.en: : That’s right. All you can do is just be that adult.
lines.zh: : 没错。你能做的，就是当那个成年人。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree17
: I hope you don’t mind pulling an all-nighter, though, Sensei. I hear it gets harder the older you get.
lines.zh: : 不过希望你别介意通宵，Sensei。我听说年纪越大越熬不动。

lines.en: : Wait, we’re going to be out all night?
lines.zh: : 等等，我们要在外面待一整晚？

lines.en: : Is that a problem? We don’t have school tomorrow, so there’s nothing you need to worry about being late for.
lines.zh: : 有问题吗？明天不用上学，所以没什么需要你担心迟到的事。

lines.en: : Nothing except sleeping, you mean. I can’t remember the last time I stayed out for the entire night.
lines.zh: : 你是说除了睡觉之外没什么。我都记不清上一次在外面待一整晚是什么时候了。

lines.en: : Well, make sure you remember this time. It would hurt my feelings if you were to ever forget it.
lines.zh: : 那这次一定要记住。你要是忘了，我会伤心的。

lines.en: : If I can stay awake through the whole thing, I promise to do just that.
lines.zh: : 只要我能全程保持清醒，我保证记住。

lines.en: : And if you can’t?
lines.zh: : 要是你撑不住呢？

lines.en: : Then...
: I guess {i}I’ll{/i} be the one passed out in an alley somewhere.
lines.zh: : 那大概昏死在小巷里的人就是{i}我了{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
I follow Makoto as she sets off down a street and at least {i}appears{/i} to know where she’s going.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Makoto 沿街出发，她至少{i}看起来{/i}知道自己要去哪儿。

lines.en: I don’t really have any reason to be skeptical since, despite the differences in our age, she surely knows much more about the surrounding areas than I do...
lines.zh: 我实在没什么理由怀疑，因为尽管我们年龄不同，她对周围这一带肯定比我熟得多……

lines.en: But I guess I’m a little skeptical nonetheless.
lines.zh: 但我想我还是有点怀疑。

lines.en: Not because I don’t trust her, but because I think that, somewhere in the back of my mind, I {i}want{/i} her to be wrong.
lines.zh: 不是因为我不信任她，而是因为我觉得，在我脑子深处的某个地方，我{i}希望{/i}她是错的。

lines.en: I just...
lines.zh: 我只是……

lines.en: Probably couldn’t tell you why if you wanted me to.
lines.zh: 大概就算你想让我说，我也说不上来为什么。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree18
My ingrained desire for Makoto to be wrong about something, as unsurprising as it is, does not come to fruition.
lines.zh: 我那种希望 Makoto 在某件事上出错的执念，尽管毫不意外，并没有成真。

lines.en: We make it to the urban district in what seems like no time at all and spend a good half an hour or so wandering through the glow of neon and passing under billboards reminding us to smile.
lines.zh: 我们似乎没花什么时间就到了商业区，接着花了大概半个钟头，在霓虹的光晕里游荡，从一块块提醒我们要微笑的广告牌下走过。

lines.en: I’d spit in their faces if I were fifty feet tall but, unfortunately, I’m stuck here on the ground as a slightly-above-average sized male.
lines.zh: 如果我有五十英尺高，我真想往它们脸上啐一口，可惜我只能困在地面上，当个身材略高于平均水平的男人。

lines.en: Thankfully, being next to Makoto makes me feel much larger.
lines.zh: 幸好，站在 Makoto 旁边让我觉得自己大上不少。

lines.en: To be frank, being next to {i}most{/i} girls makes me feel much larger.
lines.zh: 说实话，站在{i}大多数{/i}女孩旁边都让我觉得自己大上不少。

lines.en: I’m just significantly more aware of that fact when I’m alone with them in the dark.
lines.zh: 只是在黑暗里跟她们独处时，我对这一点格外清醒。

lines.en: : So, is there anywhere you’d like to go, Sensei? Dinner, perhaps?
lines.zh: : 那么，有什么你想去的地方吗，Sensei？吃个晚饭什么的？

lines.en: : Sure. Having a first date at 2:00 AM in an unfamiliar part of town will make a great story for the grandkids we’ll never have.
lines.zh: : 当然。凌晨两点在城里一个陌生地段进行第一次约会，讲给我们永远不会有的孙辈听，会是个很棒的故事。

lines.en: : Okay, so {i}no{/i} dinner. I’m afraid I don’t have many more suggestions, though, if you’re not in the mood to eat.
lines.zh: : 好，那就{i}不吃{/i}晚饭。不过如果你没心情吃东西，我恐怕也没什么别的建议了。

lines.en: : Just walking is fine. We don’t really need to do anything.
lines.zh: : 就这么走走挺好。我们其实不需要做什么。

lines.en: : Are you saying you’re happy as long as you’re with me?
lines.zh: : 你是在说，只要和我在一起你就开心？

lines.en: : Do you actually think that’s something I would say?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会说这种话？

lines.en: : No, but that doesn’t mean I wouldn’t like to hear it.
lines.zh: : 不觉得，但这不代表我不想听。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree19
: Since we don’t have any plans, how about we go somewhere with a better vantage point?
lines.zh: : 既然我们没什么计划，不如去个视野更好的地方？

lines.en: : Coming here may have killed any chance we have for the quiet of the night to make its beauty apparent, but that doesn’t mean the sights need to die as well.
lines.zh: : 来这儿也许已经毁掉了夜的静谧展现其美的任何可能，但这不代表风景也得跟着陪葬。

lines.en: : We can simply enjoy ourselves somewhere slightly closer to the sky.
lines.zh: : 我们可以在一个离天空稍微近一点的地方，单纯地享受就好。

lines.en: : Sure. Wherever you want to go is fine.
lines.zh: : 行。你想去哪儿都行。

lines.en: : I’m getting tired of these billboards anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我也看腻了这些广告牌。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree20
: What’s wrong? Not a fan of pop music?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？不喜欢流行乐？

lines.en: : I guess not.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: scene black
We find our way to a staircase I can’t even see the top of.
lines.zh: 我们摸到了一段楼梯，我甚至看不到它的尽头。

lines.en: And while some people might be consumed by curiosity at the sight of something like this, I just feel even more exhausted.
lines.zh: 看到这种景象，有些人可能会被好奇心吞没，可我只觉得更累了。

lines.en: I’m tired.
lines.zh: 我累了。

lines.en: I guess getting older really {i}does{/i} make staying awake throughout the night harder.
lines.zh: 看来年纪变大，{i}真的{/i}会让熬夜变得更难。

lines.en: We begin to ascend and each and every step feels like walking on glass.
lines.zh: 我们开始往上爬，每迈出一步都像踩在玻璃上。

lines.en: But somehow, Makoto manages to maintain a smile as her feet are cut open.
lines.zh: 但不知怎么的，Makoto 在被割开的双脚之下，还是维持着微笑。

lines.en: It’s admirable.
lines.zh: 这很令人佩服。

lines.en: Not how she can be happy at a time like this-
lines.zh: 不是佩服她在这种时候还能开心——

lines.en: But how she can be so good at pretending nothing is wrong when everything is.
lines.zh: 而是佩服她能如此擅长在一切都糟糕透顶时装作什么都没发生。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree21
: Do you like heights, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢高处吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : They...exist. I don’t really care one way or the other.
lines.zh: : 它们……存在吧。说不上喜欢还是讨厌。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I{/i} love them.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}很喜欢。

lines.en: : I have since I was little.
lines.zh: : 从小就喜欢。

lines.en: : I rode on my dad’s shoulders a lot when I was a baby, so I’ve got tons of memories of just...looking down on everything. Feeling like I’m flying.
lines.zh: : 我小时候常骑在爸爸肩膀上，所以有好多记忆就是……俯瞰一切。感觉自己在飞。

lines.en: : Of course, I’m not a baby anymore and sitting on someone’s shoulders would barely constitute a “height” at all-
lines.zh: : 当然，我已经不是小宝宝了，坐在别人肩膀上根本算不上什么「高处」——

lines.en: : But I guess that makes me appreciate places like this even more.
lines.zh: : 可我想，这反而让我更珍惜这样的地方。

lines.en: : Or...any place where I can take in a lot at once.
lines.zh: : 或者说……任何能让我一眼看进很多东西的地方。

lines.en: : The world is so big...and you and I are so small.
lines.zh: : 世界那么大……而你和我这么小。

lines.en: : And...you {i}like{/i} that? How insignificant we are in the grand scheme of things?
lines.zh: : 然后呢……你{i}喜欢{/i}这一点？喜欢我们在整个宏大图景里有多微不足道？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太是。

lines.en: : I just like the lights.
lines.zh: : 我只是喜欢那些灯。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: The night has reached a point where even here, in what I assume is the busiest place in all of Kumon-mi, has fallen silent apart from the distant music and scattered car alarms.
lines.zh: 夜已深到这个地步——即使是这里，我猜是整个 Kumon-mi 最热闹的地方，除了远处的音乐和零星的汽车警报，也已陷入寂静。

lines.en: A gust of wind joins the fray every now and then- but even those are fleeting. The same way the occasional moments where Makoto’s eyes meet mine are.
lines.zh: 不时会有一阵风加入进来——可连那些也是转瞬即逝。就像 Makoto 的目光偶尔与我相碰的那一刻一样。

lines.en: We look away each time despite there not being a reason to.
lines.zh: 每一次，我们都在没有理由的情况下移开了视线。

lines.en: I wouldn’t be surprised if there was still some evidence of my semen on her that persisted through a bath or shower or whatever method she uses to get herself clean.
lines.zh: 如果她身上还残留着我精液的痕迹——哪怕她洗过澡、冲过凉，或用别的什么方式把自己弄干净了——我也不会惊讶。

lines.en: But even with that in mind, we still look away.
lines.zh: 可即便如此，我们还是移开了视线。

lines.en: I can’t tell if I like that or not.
lines.zh: 我说不清自己喜不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : Can I...ask a question that may or may not ruin the mood?
lines.zh: : 我能……问一个可能会、也可能不会破坏气氛的问题吗？

lines.en: : The only mood I have right now is “tired,” so you can go ahead and ask whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 我现在唯一的心情就是「累」，所以你想问什么就问吧。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : What are we?
lines.zh: : 我们是什么关系？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that up until recently, I always looked at us as mentor and apprentice. Or teacher and student. A whole bunch of things like that.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，直到不久之前，我一直把我们的关系看成导师与学徒。或者老师与学生。诸如此类的一堆东西。

lines.en: : But it’s harder for me to view us as two separate entities now that we’re closer to becoming one.
lines.zh: : 可现在我们越来越接近于融为一体，我很难再把我们看成两个独立的个体了。

lines.en: : So I just wanted to hear your thoughts on the matter.
lines.zh: : 所以我只是想听听你对这件事的想法。

lines.en: : You’re you and I’m me. That’s all it is and that’s all it needs to be.
lines.zh: : 你是你，我是我。就是这样，也只需要是这样。

lines.en: : I figured you’d say something like that.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会这么说。

lines.en: : Well, I’m sorry for being predictable.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉我这么好猜。

lines.en: : You don’t have to apologize, Sensei. I wouldn’t have it any other way.
lines.zh: : 你不用道歉，Sensei。换种说法我反倒不想要。

lines.en: : It’s not as if I imagined you’d come out and say we’re dating when, as nice as that sounds, it would be near-impossible to execute correctly.
lines.zh: : 我也没指望你会直接说我们在交往——那听起来是挺好，可真要执行起来几乎不可能不出错。

lines.en: : Not to mention how many rules it would be breaking.
lines.zh: : 更别提那会打破多少条规矩。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : Maybe one day.
lines.zh: : 也许有一天吧。

lines.en: : Don’t talk. I don’t want you to ruin the life I’m imagining right now.
lines.zh: : 别说话。我可不想让你毁掉我此刻正在想象的人生。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Can I ask you one more thing, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我能再问你一件事吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Oh, am I allowed to talk again?
lines.zh: : 哦，我现在可以说话了？

lines.en: : Just for this next question. After that, you can go back to being silent.
lines.zh: : 只限下一个问题。之后你可以继续沉默。

lines.en: : Then ask away, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那就问吧。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Were you really serious when you said you wouldn’t have sex with me earlier?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说不会和我做爱，是真的吗？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene makotonewthree22
: Are you kidding me right now?
lines.zh: : 你是在开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : I know you’re not asleep.
lines.zh: : 我知道你没睡着。

lines.en: : Can’t hear you. Sleeping.
lines.zh: : 听不见。睡着了。

lines.en: : It was a serious question, you know. Because I still don’t understand why you wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 那可是个认真的问题，你知道吗。因为我到现在还是不明白你为什么不——

lines.en: : Can’t hear you. Sleeping.
lines.zh: : 听不见。睡着了。

lines.en: scene makotonewthree23
: I’ve made a horrible mistake, haven’t I?...
lines.zh: : 我犯了个可怕的错误，是吧？……

lines.en: scene black
We don’t last the rest of the night.
lines.zh: 我们没能撑过剩下的夜。

lines.en: In fact, we don’t even last another hour.
lines.zh: 事实上，我们连一个小时都没撑到。

lines.en: Not wanting to walk all the way back, Makoto uses an app on her phone to call us a ride.
lines.zh: 不想一路走回去，Makoto 用手机上的软件叫了辆车。

lines.en: The car shows up within minutes and we wind up in our beds before the sun even starts to rise.
lines.zh: 车几分钟就到了，太阳还没开始升起，我们就已经躺回了自己的床上。

lines.en: Makoto goes to sleep thinking about me.
lines.zh: Makoto 是想着我睡着的。

lines.en: Then I go to sleep thinking about someone else.
lines.zh: 而我是想着别人睡着的。

lines.en: $ makoto_love += 1
$ makotonew3 = True
{i}Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！{/i}
